svg.text: ABOUT ME
Currently
I am currently an AI Trainee at Calibo AI Academy, where I am strengthening my practical understanding of
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning through hands-on learning, projects, problem-solving,
communication, and teamwork.
Alongside AI, I am improving my foundations in DSA, SQL, Python, Java, Cloud Computing, and DevOps,
while continuously experimenting with new technologies and building practical solutions.
My Journey
My journey in technology began with a strong academic foundation through a Diploma in Computer Science
Engineering, where I developed practical programming and problem-solving skills. I am currently pursuing
my B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, expanding my knowledge in Artificial Intelligence,
Computer Vision, and modern software development while continuously working on real-world projects.
What I Build
I enjoy creating intelligent and practical technology solutions that turn ideas into working applications.
My interests include Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, Computer Vision, Python,
Java, and Web Development.
I enjoy understanding how intelligent systems work, building projects from the ground up, experimenting with
new technologies, and continuously improving through hands-on development.
My Goal
My goal is to gain valuable industry experience, contribute to innovative projects, and grow into an
AI Engineer or Full-Stack Developer. In the long term, I aspire to build technology products that
combine intelligence, creativity, and usability to solve real-world problems and create a meaningful impact.
